name: LW Postcode Autofill for WooCommerce
author: lovewoo-team

sections.description:
Enter addresses twice as fast and naturally improve checkout completion!

LW Postcode Autofill for WooCommerce shortens the lengthy Classic Checkout process. Enter a supported postcode and the matching city and district fields are filled automatically.

Make a noticeable improvement:

  • ✅ Reduce form-filling frustration.
  • ✅ Reduce data-entry errors.
  • ✅ Avoid empty address fields.

WooCommerce’s native checkout, payment, and order workflows remain unchanged.

What the plugin does

  • Autofills supported city and district fields from a postcode.
  • Supports Taiwan, Hong Kong, Macau, Singapore, and Malaysia address assistance.
  • Keeps unsupported countries on the native WooCommerce address flow.
  • Provides one enable setting and a synchronized live preview in WordPress admin.
  • Uses the WordPress user language for the installed plugin name, admin menu, and settings interface.
  • Shows Traditional Chinese-only copy when the WordPress user language is Traditional Chinese, and English-only copy for English users.

Compatibility and boundaries

  • Built primarily for WooCommerce Classic Checkout.
  • Declares compatibility with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
  • Does not change payment authorization, payment callbacks, order status transitions, or the order-received page.
  • Keeps convenience-store pickup address ownership in the relevant shipping or logistics plugin.
  • Uses bundled postcode data and does not send shopper address data to an external service.
  • Does not include analytics or usage tracking.

Features

  • Taiwan 3-digit postcode assistance for city and district fields.
  • Supported address assistance for Hong Kong, Macau, Singapore, and Malaysia.
  • Native WooCommerce fallback for unsupported countries.
  • Mobile-friendly checkout fields for Safari and Chrome.
  • Locale-aware WordPress admin interface.
  • Settings-synchronized live preview.
  • HPOS compatibility declaration.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress admin, go to Plugins > Add Plugin.
  2. Search for “LW Postcode Autofill for WooCommerce” and select Install Now, or upload the LoveWoo plugin ZIP supplied for testing.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. Open “LW Postcode Autofill for WooCommerce” in the left admin menu. In Traditional Chinese, the menu name is “自動帶地址”.
  5. Confirm that postcode autofill is enabled.
  6. Open a Classic Checkout page and test a supported postcode.
sections.faq:
Which countries or regions are supported?

The plugin currently assists addresses for Taiwan, Hong Kong, Macau, Singapore, and Malaysia.

What happens for an unsupported country?

The native WooCommerce address flow remains in control. The plugin does not force Taiwan-specific fields on unsupported countries.

Does the plugin modify payment processing?

No. It only assists supported postcode and address fields. Payment authorization, callbacks, failures, success states, and order status transitions remain controlled by WooCommerce and the active payment gateway.

Does it affect Apple Pay, LINE Pay, or card payments?

No. The plugin does not change those payment lifecycles.

Does it support HPOS?

Yes. The plugin declares HPOS compatibility and does not directly manage the order lifecycle.

Does it send address information to an external service?

No. Supported postcode data is bundled with the plugin, and the plugin does not include analytics or usage tracking.

Does it interfere with convenience-store pickup?

No. Store selection and pickup information remain owned by the active shipping or logistics plugin. Postcode Autofill only assists supported checkout address fields.
